column7: sosa:Result is broader (any result); gmeow:CoordinateMatrix is specifically a multi-dimensional numeric result with frame, unit, and determinacy.
A MentalReferenceFrame is a reference system for mental/subjective coordinates, not a process itself; it is related to the mental processes (MF) that produce or consume coordinates in it.
A SensoryEnvironment is the feature of interest that sensory observations are about — the ambient conditions at a location×time.

SOSA does not distinguish observation types; a sensory observation is a kind of sosa:Observation. Already aligned in observations.ttl; repeated here for completeness of the sensory-environment mapping set.

A SensoryPerception is a standpoint-indexed perceptual claim; obomf:perceptual process is the broader BFO-based process class. Directional: GMEOW adds the reference-frame coordinate result and standpoint indexing.
A SensoryPerception is a standpoint-indexed observation; SOSA does not distinguish observation types. The vantage (perceiver) aligns to sosa:madeBySensor.
A measured condition is the result of a sensory observation. Directional: GMEOW reifies the environment separately from the observation.
The affective circumplex frame is a coordinate reference system for emotion processes (MFOEM); the frame itself is not an emotion.
The Russell affective circumplex frame models the valence×arousal space in which affective processes (MFOEM) are situated. The frame is the reference system, not the process itself.
